description.en: Unlocks a technique/skill for a character, identified by their base parameter ID and the skill's ID.
ID of the skill to unlock, e.g. "whd0008".
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Unlock a technique for a character
CMND_SKILL_UNLOCK("para_cp0008", "whd0008");
